adoptions.description: Fixed type reconstruction for mutually recursive schemas. The maintainer retained the fix and tests, removed unrelated workflow commits, preserved co-author attribution, and merged the change into `main`.
Fixed partial updates of non-public Record types. The maintainer retained the original author's commit, added accessor caching and release notes, and merged the change into `3.x`.
Fixed skipping of extra structured values for array-shaped builders. The maintainer retained the fix, tests and original author's commit, added release notes, and merged the change into `3.x`.

Ryan continued and refined the original fix, retained [author commit 22cc9e4](https://github.com/solidjs/solid/commit/22cc9e4c6b097a0b6d7d149013f52f7568fab88d), and merged it into `next` via [commit 718ec9c](https://github.com/solidjs/solid/commit/718ec9c218643dfe9943f05d33ccb66db53621c6).
Imported into `master` through Copybara; the author of [commit c0a8a1e](https://github.com/google/guava/commit/c0a8a1edc69393e8141424037571d9825f5fc0f4) is linked to this account.
